sections.heading: What Is a WhatsApp AI Chatbot and How Does It Work?

blocks.html: A WhatsApp AI chatbot is software that chats with your customers on WhatsApp the way a good support agent would — answering questions, sharing product details, booking appointments and collecting lead details, instantly and around the clock. It runs on the WhatsApp Business Platform, which means it works on the same app your customers already open twenty times a day. When someone messages you, the bot understands the question, pulls the right answer, and replies in seconds. When the conversation needs a human, it hands over to your team with the full chat history attached — nobody repeats themselves.

items.title: Why WhatsApp and not a website widget?
items.desc: Website visitors leave. WhatsApp conversations stay in the customer's inbox forever, and messages there get read within minutes — which is why WhatsApp automation consistently outperforms email and web chat for follow-ups.

items.title: Speed is the whole game:
items.desc: Most leads go cold because the reply came hours late. A chatbot answers in under a second, at 2 pm or 2 am — and Ojiva AI clients typically see a 38% lift in conversions in the first month simply because nobody waits anymore.

items.title: Bots don't replace your team — they clear the queue:
items.desc: Let automation handle the repetitive 80% (store hours, order status, pricing, availability) so your people spend their day on the conversations that actually need judgment.

sections.heading: Rule-Based Chatbots vs AI-Powered Chatbots: What's the Difference?

blocks.html: Here's the part most providers won't tell you: many "AI chatbots" sold in India are really rule-based flow builders — press 1 for sales, press 2 for support. Useful, but the moment a customer types a real question, the bot breaks. A genuine conversational AI understands typed messages, switches languages mid-chat and gets smarter with every conversation. Both have their place; you just shouldn't pay AI prices for a menu.

sections.heading: WhatsApp Chatbot Pricing in India: What It Really Costs

blocks.html: Chatbot pricing confuses people because there are two bills, not one. Your provider charges a platform fee for the bot, builder and dashboard. Meta separately charges per template message you send — marketing messages cost the most, utility messages less, and replies inside the 24-hour customer service window are free. That last part matters: most of what a chatbot does is replying to customers who messaged first, which costs you nothing on the Meta side. Add 18% GST, billed in INR, and that's the whole picture.
